extracted.name: Coconut Curry Pumpkin Soup
extracted.description: This vegan pumpkin soup recipe includes curry powder and coriander and uses coconut oil instead of butter and light coconut milk in place of cream.
instruction_lines: Melt coconut oil in a deep pot over medium-high heat. Add onions and garlic; cook and stir until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in vegetable broth, curry powder, salt, coriander, and pepper flakes; cook and stir until mixture comes to a gentle boil, about 10 minutes. Cover the pot; boil for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Whisk in pumpkin and coconut milk until incorporated; cook for 5 minutes.

Fill blender halfway with soup. Cover and hold lid down with a potholder; pulse a few times before leaving on to blend. Pour into a pot. Repeat with remaining soup. Reheat briefly over medium heat before serving.
